items.title: Reactor FastH3 README
items.claim: The project describes hard clip boundaries, no subject, framing, or voice continuity across independently generated clips, and its stated four-B200 timing profile.

items.title: Reactor FastH3 streaming client README
items.claim: The client documents separate queues, automatic playout, a paced RTMP output clock, and repeated-frame or silent gap behavior.

items.title: Comfy: MiniMax H3 Day-0 Support
items.claim: Comfy says pruning, INT8 ConvRot, and dynamic VRAM offloading reduce its smallest H3 variants’ memory footprint and open a local route on a GPU like an RTX 3060.

items.title: H3 Max Director
items.claim: The provider describes a held WebRTC session, carried segment context, current price conditions, and a public session limit.

items.title: FastVideo FastH3 Goes Local
items.claim: FastVideo reports local M4 Max and one- or two-DGX-Spark FastH3 Preview timings, including full-VAE and TAEH3 conditions.

items.title: FastVideo MiniMax H3 cookbook
items.claim: The cookbook defines the local MLX and DGX Spark paths and limits the MLX FastH3 Preview route to T2VA.

items.title: MiniMax H3 ComfyUI workflows for 16 GB VRAM
items.claim: One author reports a condition-rich RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB MiniMax H3 workflow and stated offline clip timings.

items.title: What is MiniMax H3 Max Director?
items.claim: A first-party learning article gives different session and audio details from the endpoint page.

items.title: MiniMax H3 repository
items.claim: The repository documents local 4–15 second base clips and separate task-specific checkpoint families.

items.title: 8 GB H3 FL2V community report
items.claim: One author reports a constrained 8 GB laptop workflow and its stated runtime conditions.

items.title: ComfyUI issue #15665
items.claim: One open issue reports a version-specific H3 performance concern under stated conditions.
